data.name: App_Settings_Aaguid_Description
data.value: Override the authenticator identifier (AAGUID) that websites see when you create a passkey. Leave empty to use the default. Applying re-registers the authenticator with Windows.

data.name: App_Settings_Aaguid_Invalid
data.value: Enter a valid GUID, or leave empty to use the default.

data.name: App_Settings_About_ThirdPartyDescription
data.value: Open source licenses for bundled libraries

data.name: App_Settings_Advanced_Description
data.value: Behaviour, timing and logging settings that are rarely changed

data.name: App_Settings_Algorithms_Description
data.value: Which algorithm a new passkey gets when the website accepts several. A website that accepts only algorithms that are off can't create a passkey.

data.name: App_Settings_ApprovalTimeout_Description
data.value: How long the confirmation prompt stays open

data.name: App_Settings_BackupEligibility_Description
data.value: When on, websites are told that a new passkey is allowed to be backed up and synced to your other devices. When off, they are told it is saved on a single device only.

data.name: App_Settings_BackupState_Description
data.value: When on, websites are told that a new passkey is backed up right now. Only available while "Backup Eligibility" is on.

data.name: App_Settings_DuplicateCheck_Description
data.value: Where to enforce a website's request not to add a second passkey for an account it already has one for.

data.name: App_Settings_Enforced_Message
data.value: These settings come from KeePass.config.enforced.xml and can't be changed here.

data.name: App_Settings_Entries_Description
data.value: How new passkey entries are created

data.name: App_Settings_EntryGroup_Description
data.value: Passkeys group: the default group for passkeys. Selected group: the group selected in KeePass when creating the passkey.

data.name: App_Settings_EntryTitle_Description
data.value: Title for new entries. Supports {RP_NAME} and KeePass placeholders like {USERNAME} or {URL}.

data.name: App_Settings_ErrorNotifications_Description
data.value: Show a detailed notification when a passkey error occurs (Windows always displays a generic error)

data.name: App_Settings_Expert_Description
data.value: Advanced options for uncommon setups. Change only if you know why.

data.name: App_Settings_LegacyPrompts_Description
data.value: Show confirmation prompts as Windows notifications instead of dialogs. Notifications are silently hidden by Focus Assist and Do Not Disturb, and their pickers are limited to 5 items.

data.name: App_Settings_LoadFailed
data.value: Could not load the latest settings from KeePass. Showing the last known values.

data.name: App_Settings_LogLevel_Description
data.value: Verbosity of the provider and plugin log files

data.name: App_Settings_PluginUpdates_Description
data.value: When KeePass starts, offer to update the plugin if this app ships a newer one. Every update is confirmed in a dialog.

data.name: App_Settings_RefreshInterval_Description
data.value: How often the app polls for provider status

data.name: App_Settings_RegistrationVerification_Description
data.value: How you approve saving a new passkey

data.name: App_Settings_ResolvePlaceholders_Description
data.value: On: placeholders are resolved and the final text is saved in the title. Off: KeePass resolves them each time the entry is shown. {RP_NAME} is always resolved on save.

data.name: App_Settings_SaveFailedNotRunning
data.value: KeePass is not running. Start KeePass with the passkey plugin before saving settings.

data.name: App_Settings_SaveToExisting_Description
data.value: Offer to save a passkey onto a matching entry instead of always creating a new one. Requires the registration confirmation prompt.

data.name: App_Settings_SaveToExisting_Header
data.value: Offer saving to an existing entry

data.name: App_Settings_SkipHelloAfterUnlock_Description
data.value: When KeePass was locked and you just unlocked it for this request, don't ask for Windows Hello again. Only applies while the confirmation prompt is on

data.name: App_Settings_SkipHelloAfterUnlock_Header
data.value: Skip Windows Hello after unlocking KeePass

data.name: App_Settings_TagEntries_Description
data.value: Add a "Passkey" tag to each entry created when a new passkey is registered

data.name: App_Settings_TrayIcon_Description
data.value: Show a status icon in the system tray. Closing the window keeps the app running in the tray.

data.name: App_Settings_Verification_Description
data.value: Confirmation prompts and user verification for passkey operations

data.name: App_Settings_Verification_SilentWarning
data.value: Both are off, so passkey operations will complete without asking you.

data.name: App_Settings_WindowsCache_Description
data.value: Shares the website and user name of your passkeys with Windows (never the keys themselves), so Windows can offer them when you sign in. When off, Windows doesn't know about your passkeys and sign-in fails on most sites.
